title: ALMA CO-CAVITY: I. Resolved molecular gas in void galaxies
question: How are detailed molecular gas properties and their connection to star formation and stellar content influenced by large-scale and local environments in void galaxies?

recipe.goal: Combine multi-configuration ALMA data and image CO(1-0) data cubes
recipe.method: Use QA2 pipeline products directly for 15 single-configuration (C-3) galaxies; for 26 two-configuration galaxies, subtract continuum with uvcontsub, concatenate MS files with concat, and clean with tclean using auto-multithresh and primary beam correction.
key_parameters: robust = 0.5, threshold = 2 sigma, channel width = 10 km s^-1, pixel size = 0.1'', auto-multithresh

recipe.goal: Rebin, smooth, and regrid data cubes to match optical IFU resolution
recipe.method: Rebin cubes spectrally to 10 km s^-1 with imrebin, smooth spatially to a circular 2.5'' PSF with imsmooth, and regrid to match PPak (1.0'') or MaNGA (0.5'') pixel grids with imregrid.
key_parameters: spectral resolution = 10 km s^-1, circular PSF = 2.5'', pixel size = 1.0'' (PPak) or 0.5'' (MaNGA)

recipe.goal: Generate 3D emission masks, measure integrated CO(1-0) fluxes, and classify detections
recipe.method: Crop cubes to +/- 300 km s^-1 around optical velocity and run SoFiA 2 S+C finder using primary beam weights. For failed masks, apply an elliptical mask based on d25, PA, and inclination over +/- 150 km s^-1. Integrate flux within masks and classify by S/N.
key_parameters: S+C finder S/N clip = 3.5, linking radius = 1 pixel and 1 channel, reliability S/N threshold = 3
assumptions: Delta V = 300 km s^-1 assumed for non-detection upper limits

recipe.goal: Produce native-resolution moment maps and position-velocity diagrams for the Atlas
recipe.method: Compute moment-0, 1, and 2 maps using immoments over the detected channel range and 3D mask, and compute PV diagrams along the galaxy PA using impv.

recipe.goal: Derive global molecular gas masses and 2.5'' resolved physical surface density maps
recipe.method: Calculate L'_CO using Solomon et al. (1997) and convert to M_H2 using metallicity- and SFMS-dependent alpha_CO from Accurso et al. (2017). Derive resolved Sigma_star, Sigma_SFR, 12+log(O/H), and Sigma_H2 maps at 2.5'' resolution.
assumptions: LambdaCDM cosmology with H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.30, Omega_Lambda = 0.70; Chabrier (2003) IMF
alpha_CO includes a factor of 1.36 for heavy elements; 12+log(O/H) capped at 8.8 for Accurso et al. (2017) prescription

recipe.goal: Fit global scaling relations (SK, MGMS, SFMS) and compare across environments
recipe.method: Perform Orthogonal Distance Regression (ODR) fits to global M_H2, M_star, and SFR for ALMA CO-CAVITY and comparison samples converted to a Chabrier IMF.
assumptions: Chabrier IMF and 1.36 helium/heavy element factor applied uniformly across surveys
